current.text: Dejounte Murray is locked into the starting lineup and starts over Fears, which limits Fears's lead guard role.
The last starting spot is between Fears and Herb Jones. A Pelicans beat reporter thinks Fears will start over Jones, and reporting says Joe Dumars wants Fears in the lineup.
Josh gives Fears at least a 50/50 chance to start over Herb Jones. He would draft Fears only if he starts.
The Pelicans have more players than 240 minutes can hold. About eight players could start, so minutes will be tight.
New coach Jamahl Mosley brings a defense-first identity to New Orleans.
The Pelicans are expected to be a weak team, around 34 wins and near the bottom of the West. One expert still does not expect them to give up on the season and start Fears over Murray.
Experts treat him as a late flyer with upside. His ADP is between 118 and 136, and he went around pick 104 and in round 11 in mock drafts.
He is a handcuff to Dejounte Murray. If Murray gets hurt or is traded, Fears could put up top 70 numbers.
Without 30 or more minutes he projects outside the top 105. He would be clearly better with a 30-minute role.
Point guard tier 8. Letting him last to round 13 is a big underdraft.

durable.text: He is a downhill lead guard who is dynamic with the ball. He keeps attacking the rim even when he is not scoring there.
His three-point shot is not good enough to play off the ball as a two guard.
He is slightly undersized and struggles on defense.

note: Fears is priced as a 1 USD end-of-draft flyer (Yahoo rank 185, ESPN rank 120, nobody drafted him in our league), so he sits right at the edge of our 144-player pool. That price fits the upside: he ranked 117th after last season's trade deadline, and he is a natural handcuff if you take Dejounte Murray. Steals are his best category, while his 43.8 FG% and 2.3 turnovers cost a little. Before you bid, check whether he beats out Herb Jones for a starting spot and reaches about 30 minutes early in the season. If he does not, he is a waiver player until Murray misses time.
